trades.description: Designs, develops, tests, and maintains responsive client-side and full-stack web applications, accessible user interfaces, interactive component state, and structured API integrations adhering to modern web standards.
trades.prerequisites: Minimum 1 year practical web development, frontend programming, or relevant project portfolio

nosList.title: HTML and accessibility
performanceCriteria: PC1.1: Use semantic HTML5 elements (header, nav, main, section, article, footer, button) rather than non-semantic divs
PC1.2: Implement WCAG 2.1 AA accessible form controls with explicit labels, aria-labels, and error announcements
PC1.3: Ensure full keyboard navigability (tabindex, focus visible outlines, escape key dismissal)
PC1.4: Provide alternative text for images and descriptive link text
knowledgeCriteria: KC1.1: WAI-ARIA role and state attributes (aria-live, aria-expanded, aria-selected)
KC1.2: Document Object Model hierarchy and accessibility tree mapping

nosList.title: CSS and responsive design
performanceCriteria: PC2.1: Implement responsive layouts using CSS Flexbox and CSS Grid without horizontal overflow
PC2.2: Apply mobile-first media queries supporting standard viewport breakpoints (mobile, tablet, desktop)
PC2.3: Maintain accessible color contrast ratios (minimum 4.5:1 for normal text)
PC2.4: Utilize CSS custom properties (variables) for consistent design tokens and theming
knowledgeCriteria: KC2.1: CSS Box Model, specificity hierarchy, and layout rendering mechanics
KC2.2: Fluid typography and relative units (rem, em, ch, %)

nosList.title: JavaScript fundamentals
performanceCriteria: PC3.1: Write clean, idiomatic ES6+ JavaScript using modern syntax (const/let, arrow functions, destructuring)
PC3.2: Manage deterministic component state avoiding unexpected global mutations
PC3.3: Implement efficient event listeners and event delegation patterns
PC3.4: Handle asynchronous operations, Promises, and error boundary states
knowledgeCriteria: KC3.1: JavaScript Execution Context, Event Loop, and Asynchronous Microtask Queue
KC3.2: Array manipulation methods (map, filter, reduce, find, some, every) and immutability

nosList.title: Practical development
performanceCriteria: PC4.1: Construct an interactive Task-List application allowing dynamic task creation with input validation
PC4.2: Implement task completion toggle with visual feedback and state persistence
PC4.3: Provide real-time task filtering across All, Active, and Completed views
PC4.4: Support safe task deletion with immediate DOM and state synchronization
knowledgeCriteria: KC4.1: Separation of concerns between UI presentation, business logic, and data layer
KC4.2: Defensive input sanitization and XSS prevention

nosList.title: Debugging and problem-solving
performanceCriteria: PC5.1: Trace runtime flaws and logical defects using systematic debugging techniques
PC5.2: Identify and remediate unexpected state mutations and array filter anomalies
PC5.3: Verify edge case handling (empty strings, whitespace-only inputs, case sensitivity)
PC5.4: Run unit tests to prove regression-free defect resolution
knowledgeCriteria: KC5.1: Browser DevTools debugging, breakpoints, and console profiling
KC5.2: Unit test assertions and test-driven verification

nosList.title: Technical explanation
performanceCriteria: PC6.1: Clearly explain component design, state architecture, and trade-offs in technical writing
PC6.2: Articulate accessibility decisions and browser compatibility considerations
knowledgeCriteria: KC6.1: Software design patterns for frontend architecture and modular code design

vivaScenarios.scenario: Explain how you ensure your web application remains accessible for keyboard-only and screen-reader users, and how you prevent XSS vulnerabilities when displaying user-entered task titles in the DOM.

trades.description: An Assistant Electrician assists in installation, testing, and maintenance of basic electrical wiring, fixtures, earthing systems, and cable laying under supervision.
trades.prerequisites: Minimum 1 year informal work experience in domestic wiring or electrical fittings

nosList.title: Select, inspect and prepare electrical tools and materials
performanceCriteria: PC1.1: Verify insulation rating of hand tools before initiating work
PC1.2: Select correct wire gauge (1.5 sq mm, 2.5 sq mm, 4 sq mm) according to circuit load specifications
PC1.3: Inspect test instruments (multimeter, continuity tester) for zero error and calibration
PC1.4: Prepare PVC conduits and junction boxes free from sharp burrs
knowledgeCriteria: KC1.1: Understanding color coding standards (Phase: Red/Yellow/Blue, Neutral: Black, Earth: Green/Yellow)
KC1.2: Current carrying capacities of copper vs aluminum conductors

nosList.title: Install wiring, switchboards, and distribution systems
performanceCriteria: PC2.1: Strip cable ends without notching or damaging copper conductor strands
PC2.2: Make secure mechanical and electrical connections using proper crimping lugs and terminal screws
PC2.3: Route cables inside PVC/casing conduits maintaining minimum bend radius
PC2.4: Mount and level switchboards, MCBs (Miniature Circuit Breakers), and socket outlets securely
PC2.5: Connect earth lead securely to 3-pin sockets and main earthing terminal
knowledgeCriteria: KC2.1: Principle of MCB trip rating (B-curve, C-curve) and short circuit protection
KC2.2: Difference between series and parallel circuits in domestic wiring

nosList.title: Perform basic earthing and circuit continuity testing
performanceCriteria: PC3.1: Carry out continuity test of Phase, Neutral, and Earth conductors using multimeter
PC3.2: Verify polarity of live and neutral at all socket outlets
PC3.3: Inspect earthing electrode and ensure proper connection to main distribution board
PC3.4: Test insulation resistance between live-neutral and live-earth using megohmmeter
knowledgeCriteria: KC3.1: Permissible earthing resistance limits (< 1 ohm domestic, < 5 ohm commercial)
KC3.2: Danger of open neutral and floating ground conditions

nosList.title: Health, safety, and emergency procedures at electrical work sites
performanceCriteria: PC4.1: Follow Lock-Out/Tag-Out (LOTO) and de-energization verification procedures prior to contact
PC4.2: Don appropriate PPE (gloves, helmet, dielectric footwear) at all work times
PC4.3: Demonstrate first-aid response for electric shock and knowledge of CO2/Dry Powder fire extinguishers
PC4.4: Keep workplace clean, free of moisture and trip hazards
knowledgeCriteria: KC4.1: Electric shock treatment protocol and CPR basics
KC4.2: Classification of electrical fires (Class C) and extinguisher selection

vivaScenarios.scenario: A customer reports that whenever they turn on a 1.5-ton split AC, the MCB trips immediately with a spark. How will you systematically troubleshoot this?
You are installing a sub-distribution board with 3 lighting circuits and 2 power plug circuits. What wire gauge will you select for each and why?
expectedKeywords: 2.5 or 4 sq mm for power plugs (16A)

trades.description: Installs, tests, commissions, and maintains complex 3-phase commercial and industrial electrical distribution boards, control panels, motors, and automation switches.
trades.prerequisites: Minimum 2-3 years practical experience in 3-phase wiring or industrial panel assembly
mandatoryPPE: High voltage rated dielectric gloves (Class 1 / 7500V rated)
standardTools: Laser Distance Meter & Thermal Imaging Camera

nosList.title: Install and commission 3-phase industrial distribution panels
performanceCriteria: PC1.1: Verify phase sequence (R-Y-B) using phase rotation meter
PC1.2: Torque busbar bolt connections to manufacturer specification to prevent hotspot generation
PC1.3: Wire contactors, thermal overload relays, and star-delta motor starters correctly
PC1.4: Terminate armored aluminum/copper power cables using brass cable glands and crimped lugs
knowledgeCriteria: KC1.1: Formula for 3-phase power (P = √3 * V * I * cos φ)
KC1.2: Calculation of cable derating factors based on ambient temperature and bundling

nosList.title: Troubleshoot industrial AC motors and control circuits
performanceCriteria: PC2.1: Measure motor winding insulation resistance between phases and to earth using 500V/1000V Megger
PC2.2: Identify single phasing conditions and set protective relay limits
PC2.3: Test control circuit interlocks and emergency stop push buttons
PC2.4: Measure running current per phase and detect load imbalance > 5%
knowledgeCriteria: KC2.1: Working principle of DOL (Direct-On-Line) vs Star-Delta starter
KC2.2: Harmonic distortion causes and power factor correction capacitors

nosList.title: Industrial Earthing, Lightning Protection and Grid Safety
performanceCriteria: PC3.1: Install chemical/pipe/plate earth electrodes with bentonite/salt-charcoal mix
PC3.2: Measure earth pit resistance using Fall-of-Potential 3-pin method
PC3.3: Interconnect separate earth pits with GI/copper earthing strip for equipotential bonding
PC3.4: Inspect surge protection devices (SPD) in main incoming switchboard
knowledgeCriteria: KC3.1: Indian Standard IS 3043 code of practice for earthing
KC3.2: Step potential and touch potential hazards in sub-stations

nosList.title: Workplace Health, Environmental and Industrial Safety Standards
performanceCriteria: PC4.1: Execute Permit to Work (PTW) protocols for hazardous industrial areas
PC4.2: Inspect PPE integrity and maintain calibrated safety equipment records
PC4.3: Manage e-waste and battery disposal per environmental regulations
knowledgeCriteria: KC4.1: OSHA / Indian Factories Act safety rules for electrical sub-assemblies

vivaScenarios.scenario: A 15 kW 3-phase induction motor is running hot and drawing unequal current: Phase R=24A, Phase Y=24A, Phase B=32A. What steps will you take to diagnose the fault?
expectedKeywords: check loose termination in terminal box
check mechanical binding or bearing wear

trades.description: Performs diagnostics, routine servicing, overhauling of engine, braking, transmission, fuel injection (CRDi/MPFI), and electrical systems of automobiles.
trades.prerequisites: Minimum 2 years practical experience in garage repair or vehicle maintenance
mandatoryPPE: Ear defenders for noisy garage bays

nosList.title: Perform vehicle routine inspection and preventive maintenance
performanceCriteria: PC1.1: Position vehicle securely on two-post lift and engage safety lock bars
PC1.2: Check and replace engine oil, oil filter, air filter, and coolant to specified grades
PC1.3: Inspect drive belts tension, pulley alignment, and battery state of charge (SoC)
PC1.4: Check suspension bushes, ball joints, and steering tie-rod ends for play
knowledgeCriteria: KC1.1: Viscosity ratings of engine oils (e.g., 5W-30 vs 15W-40 API SN)
KC1.2: Coolant glycol mixture ratios and corrosion inhibitors

nosList.title: Diagnose and service automotive braking and hydraulic systems
performanceCriteria: PC2.1: Measure brake disc runout and pad thickness using vernier caliper and dial indicator
PC2.2: Bleed brake hydraulic lines in cross-sequence (RR, FL, LR, FR) removing air pockets
PC2.3: Inspect ABS wheel speed sensors, tone rings, and wiring harness
PC2.4: Clean and adjust rear drum brake shoe clearance and handbrake cable tension
knowledgeCriteria: KC2.1: Difference between DOT 3, DOT 4, and DOT 5.1 brake fluids and moisture absorption
KC2.2: Functioning of Master Cylinder, Proportioning Valve, and ABS Hydraulic Modulator

nosList.title: Diagnose engine management, sensor faults, and electronic systems
performanceCriteria: PC3.1: Connect OBD-II scanner, read Diagnostic Trouble Codes (DTCs), and analyze live sensor data streams
PC3.2: Perform dry and wet cylinder compression tests to isolate piston ring vs valve seat leaks
PC3.3: Test fuel rail pressure and injector spray patterns
PC3.4: Test oxygen sensor (O2) and MAF sensor signal voltages using digital multimeter
knowledgeCriteria: KC3.1: Common DTC codes (P0300 random misfire, P0171 system lean, P0420 catalyst efficiency)
KC3.2: Closed-loop vs Open-loop engine management and stoichiometric air-fuel ratio (14.7:1)

nosList.title: Shop Safety, Hazardous Waste Handling and Environment Rules
performanceCriteria: PC4.1: Dispose of used engine oil, brake fluid, and lead-acid batteries per CPCB norms
PC4.2: Use jack stands whenever working under elevated vehicles; never rely solely on hydraulic jack
PC4.3: Prevent fire hazards around fuel lines and use battery disconnect switches
knowledgeCriteria: KC4.1: Spillage response procedures and sawdust/adsorbent pad usage

vivaScenarios.scenario: A car comes into your workshop with 'Check Engine Light' illuminated and sluggish acceleration on uphill climbs. Scan tool shows code P0101 (Mass Air Flow Sensor Circuit Range/Performance). How will you inspect and verify?
expectedKeywords: visual check for air intake leaks
check MAF connector wiring (5V reference, ground, signal)
clean sensor with MAF cleaner spray
measure signal voltage on throttle snap

trades.description: Performs installation, repair, and maintenance of water supply pipes, drainage fittings, sanitary fixtures, and pressure testing in residential and commercial buildings.
trades.prerequisites: Minimum 1 year informal plumbing or pipe fitting experience
mandatoryPPE: Dust mask / respirator for solvent fumes

nosList.title: Cut, thread, and join CPVC, UPVC, and GI pipes
performanceCriteria: PC1.1: Measure and mark pipe lengths accounting for fitting socket depths
PC1.2: Cut pipes square using rotary pipe cutter and ream internal burrs
PC1.3: Clean pipe ends with primer, apply solvent cement uniformly, and make twist-joint within setting time
PC1.4: Cut clean threads on GI pipes and wrap Teflon tape clockwise with 4-6 tight wraps
knowledgeCriteria: KC1.1: Difference between CPVC (hot and cold water), UPVC (cold drainage), and SWR pipes
KC1.2: Curing time required for solvent weld joints before hydraulic pressure testing

nosList.title: Install sanitary fixtures, taps, valves, and drainage traps
performanceCriteria: PC2.1: Mount washbasins, water closets (EWC/IWC), and kitchen sinks maintaining specified heights and level
PC2.2: Install P-traps, S-traps, and bottle traps ensuring adequate water seal depth (minimum 50mm) to block sewer gas
PC2.3: Install angle valves, bib taps, and mixer faucets with leak-free washers and gaskets
PC2.4: Align drain pipes with minimum 1:50 (2%) fall toward inspection chambers
knowledgeCriteria: KC2.1: Purpose of vent pipes in plumbing drainage stacks to prevent siphonage of water seals
KC2.2: Standard height norms for wall-hung basins, showers, and bibcocks

nosList.title: Hydrostatic pressure testing and leak detection
performanceCriteria: PC3.1: Plug all open terminal outlets and fill system with water expelling trapped air
PC3.2: Pressurize pipe network to 1.5 times working pressure (typically 7-10 bar) using hydrostatic test pump

PC3.4: Drain system safely and flush out debris

nosList.title: Health, hygiene, and safe trench/confined space working
performanceCriteria: PC4.1: Wear protective gear when handling wastewater systems to prevent biological contamination
PC4.2: Ensure proper shoring and ventilation when working in plumbing shafts and inspection pits
knowledgeCriteria: KC4.1: Sewer gas hazards (hydrogen sulfide H2S, methane CH4) and asphyxiation prevention

vivaScenarios.scenario: A resident complains of foul sewer smell coming from their master bathroom floor drain, especially in summer. What is the root cause and how do you rectify it?
expectedKeywords: dried up water seal in floor trap
siphonage due to lack of vent pipe
install anti-siphon valve or deep-seal P-trap

trades.description: Installs, tests, and commissions rooftop and ground-mounted Solar Photovoltaic (PV) power systems, including module mounting structures, inverter connections, DC/AC cabling, and net metering checks.

mandatoryPPE: Full body fall-arrest harness with shock absorbing lanyard
standardTools: Solar PV MC4 Crimping Tool & Pin Disconnector
Incline / Angle Clinometer for tilt measurement
Thermal Imaging Camera for hotspot inspection

nosList.title: Mount solar PV modules and verify structural stability
performanceCriteria: PC1.1: Orient module mounting structure (MMS) facing true South with tilt angle optimized for latitude

performanceCriteria: PC4.1: Anchor full body harness to secure lifeline before stepping onto sloping roof
